tweets.text:
$BTC ETFs saw another massive outflow day on Wednesday. But this day ended up closing +1% in the green after a 5% intra day reversal.

Moves like these where the market is flat or up after massive ETF outflow days are generally your first signs to start paying attention.

Of course this day could have been an outlier, but if you see more of these days that usually points to strong absorption and the outflows themselves often reverse from that point too.

Over the years we've seen many local tops and bottoms on strong ETF flows. When price stops moving in the same direction of those flows is when you watch closely.

tweets.text:
US spot Bitcoin ETFs just had their worst month since launch.

And the month is not over yet.

> November net outflows: -$5.39B (prior record: -$4.51B, June 2026)
> 16 of 18 sessions in the red
> BlackRock's IBIT alone: -$4.50B
> 7 straight days of outflows, -$3.05B since Nov 17
> Cumulative inflows: $62.7B peak (Oct 2025) to $51.7B today

The same funds that pulled in $60B+ on the way up are now handing coins back while price falls. BTC is down more than 20% this month.

ETF money arrived as the strongest buyer in this cycle. Right now it is a seller.

Is this the end of the institutional bid, or just tourists leaving?

$ETH Another hold of the $1.5K level over the years.

$1750 is generally the level where this either sees a rejection or if retaken starts a move back above $2.1K+ again.

Those are your levels to watch, they didn't change in years and ETH respects them well.

quote.text:
$ETH Back at the big support level that has been tested multiple times over the past 3 years.

- October 2023 before the big rally
- April 2025 after the tariff crash right before Tom Lee & Bitmine pumped it up to $5K
- This summer 2026 before the big bounce
- Here we are

This is a key area and one I would want to see the bulls defend at all costs. Next support up would be that tariff low at ~$1350. Above, $1750 generally is the level where if price accepts back above it, we see a bigger move up.
